name: slskdn
description: slskdN is a feature-rich Soulseek web client and an unofficial batteries-included fork of slskd. FEATURES: - Auto-replace stuck downloads with alternative sources - Wishlist / background search with auto-download - Smart source ranking based on speed, queue, and history - User notes and download history badges - Block users from search results - Multiple download destinations - Delete files on disk from UI - Push notifications (Ntfy, Pushover, Pushbullet) - Tabbed browse sessions - Clear all searches button - And more... No scripts required. Everything built-in.
